Senate Bill 146

Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 146 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Examiners of
Assisted Living Administrators until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
